fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 10: the agent guide shipped in the binary (the genesis skill, the genesis-scrub skill, three topics), its install into Claude Code as a skills-directory plugin with a session-start hook, a size-cap test, a minimal status, and genesis source add. The plan file was lost when the task's worktree was removed and was recovered by the orchestrator from the task's transcripts with D1-D13 intact. Decided (D1-D13, agent wording accepted by the owner): a minimal status showing the repo, current change set, change sets needing attention and the installed guide version against the binary; source add takes a handle, a JSON file of title, summary and quotes, and --raw (or --raw-sha256), storing only the raw material's sha256, through a change set or --record, with --dry-run; the size cap counts tokens as ceil(bytes / 4), with each skill at most 2,000, each topic at most 800 and the hook output at most 100; topics change-sets, apply and sources; guide prints the skill, a topic or the scrub skill, guide ls lists them, and the text is embedded markdown in a pure internal/guide; the guide names the full milestone-1 loop and a test checks every command it names exists, with a pending allowlist for reads not yet built; status --hook is brief, silent outside a Genesis repo and always exits 0; guardrails exclude AGENTS.md, the reconcile skill and evals; install writes a skills-directory plugin at user level by default (or in the repo with --project), with no settings.json edits; a re-install rewrites our own folder and refuses a foreign one without --force; the hook runs genesis status --hook through PATH. Revised after sign-off by the orchestrator under the owner's authorization (not in the plan, applied in PR #8): the scrub skill says an option an agent wrote is never the owner's words, the core loop states the work contract and ends with genesis land, and link accepts change-set refs.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 10: the agent guide
